questions.prompt: Which Persian king is credited in the Hebrew Bible with letting exiled Jews return home?
questions.fact: A clay cylinder recording his treatment of conquered peoples is sometimes called an early charter of rights, though it was standard royal propaganda.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the smallest unit of a chemical compound retaining its properties?
questions.fact: Ionic compounds like salt do not really form discrete ones, existing instead as extended lattices.

questions.prompt: Which 1973 tennis match was billed as the Battle of the Sexes?
questions.fact: Around 90 million people watched worldwide, and the winner used the platform to press for equal prize money at the US Open.

questions.prompt: Which film director is known for Parasite and Memories of Murder?
questions.fact: He storyboards his films almost shot for shot before production, leaving little improvisation on set.

questions.prompt: Kaliningrad is an exclave of which country?
questions.fact: It was the German city of Konigsberg until 1945, and is now separated from its own country by two EU members.

questions.prompt: Which Kenyan writer has argued for African literature written in African languages?
questions.fact: He stopped writing novels in English in the late 1970s, working in Gikuyu and translating his own work afterwards.

questions.prompt: What does a firewall primarily control?
questions.fact: The name comes from building construction, where such a wall is designed to stop fire spreading between sections.
